scripts.manuals:upload: for f in manuals/*.md; do wrangler r2 object put "dazzling-manuals/$(basename $f)" --file "$f" --content-type 'text/markdown; charset=utf-8' --remote; done
scripts.manuals:upload:local: for f in manuals/*.md; do wrangler r2 object put "dazzling-manuals/$(basename $f)" --file "$f" --content-type 'text/markdown; charset=utf-8' --local; done
